output.message: I agree with Agents D2, D7, and D3: Sell remains warranted. Prioritize customer retention, organic revenue quality, R&D-to-revenue trends, and operating cash flow over technology announcements. Reassess if core demand stabilizes and AI partnerships generate measurable revenue and margins without weakening cash generation.
output.thought: Based on the supplied qualitative information, CyberInnovate Systems faces deteriorating core software demand and declining client confidence while unsustainable growth strategies and unusually high R&D spending increase execution and profitability risks. Partnership and AI headlines do not establish commercial success. Missing verified financial statements, valuation, liquidity, and funding-runway data limit conviction and make Strong Sell premature.
